 Press Releases

  • Advanced SECS/GEM Equipment Software - einnosys (20260715)

    Ahmedabad, India – July 2026 – eInnoSys, a leading provider of semiconductor factory automation solutions, will showcase its comprehensive SECS/GEM Compliance & Equipment Software portfolio at SEMICON India 2026. Designed for semiconductor equipment manufacturers (OEMs), fabs, and OSAT facilities, the solution enables rapid implementation of SEMI-compliant equipment communication while accelerating digital transformation and Industry 4.0 initiatives.

    The eInnoSys SECS/GEM software platform helps equipment manufacturers implement SECS-II (SEMI E5), GEM (SEMI E30), HSMS (SEMI E37), and GEM300 standards, enabling seamless communication between manufacturing equipment and factory Host/MES systems. The solution simplifies equipment integration, reduces development time, and ensures compliance with global semiconductor factory automation standards.

    Whether integrating new equipment or modernizing legacy tools, eInnoSys provides flexible deployment options, configurable APIs, and expert implementation services that help customers achieve faster factory acceptance, improved equipment interoperability, and reduced engineering effort.

    Visitors to SEMICON India 2026 will have the opportunity to explore how eInnoSys solutions support:

    • Rapid SECS/GEM implementation for semiconductor equipment
    • SEMI standards compliance (E5, E30, E37, GEM300)
    • Equipment-to-Host/MES connectivity
    • Legacy equipment modernization
    • Smart Factory and Industry 4.0 integration
    • Reduced implementation time and engineering costs

       
  • India's Trusted Partner for OSAT & MES Integration (20260715)

    Ahmedabad, India – July 2026 – eInnoSys, a leading provider of semiconductor factory automation solutions, is empowering India's rapidly growing semiconductor ecosystem with advanced SECS/GEM, GEM300, MES Integration, and Smart Factory solutions. Headquartered in Ahmedabad, the company helps semiconductor fabs, OSATs (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test), and equipment manufacturers accelerate digital transformation through reliable equipment connectivity and intelligent factory automation.

    As India strengthens its position as a global semiconductor manufacturing hub, eInnoSys enables manufacturers to seamlessly integrate production equipment with MES, Host, and Factory Automation systems using internationally recognized SEMI standards, including SECS-II (E5), GEM (E30), HSMS (E37), GEM300, E84, E87, E90, E94, and E116.

    The company's portfolio includes innovative solutions for legacy equipment modernization, SECS/GEM implementation, protocol conversion, AI-powered predictive maintenance, recipe management, alarm management, and visual inspection, enabling customers to improve equipment interoperability, manufacturing efficiency, traceability, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

    With successful deployments across semiconductor fabs, OSAT facilities, and OEMs, eInnoSys continues to support manufacturers in reducing implementation time, minimizing integration costs, and accelerating Smart Factory adoption without disrupting existing production environments.

    At SEMICON India 2026, visitors can explore how eInnoSys solutions help:

    • Enable SECS/GEM and GEM300 compliance
    • Integrate equipment with MES and Factory Host systems
    • Modernize legacy semiconductor equipment
    • Improve production visibility and equipment utilization
    • Accelerate Industry 4.0 and Smart Factory initiatives

    As India's semiconductor industry continues to expand, eInnoSys remains committed to delivering innovative automation solutions that help manufacturers achieve higher productivity, improved quality, and sustainable operational excellence.

    Visit eInnoSys at SEMICON India 2026 to discover how our semiconductor automation solutions can support your Smart Factory journey.

  • AI-Powered Semiconductor Factory Automation (20260715)

Designed for semiconductor fabs, OSATs, and equipment manufacturers, the company's solutions help accelerate digital transformation through intelligent equipment connectivity, predictive analytics, and smart manufacturing.

    As semiconductor manufacturing becomes increasingly data-driven, manufacturers require automation solutions that deliver real-time equipment visibility, predictive maintenance, and seamless factory integration. eInnoSys addresses these challenges with an advanced portfolio of SECS/GEM, GEM300, AI/ML Predictive Maintenance, Recipe Management, Alarm Management, Equipment Connectivity, and Smart Factory solutions.

    The company's AI-powered technologies enable manufacturers to monitor equipment health, predict potential failures before they occur, reduce unplanned downtime, improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), and optimize maintenance strategies. By integrating AI with SEMI-compliant SECS/GEM communication, eInnoSys helps customers build intelligent, connected, and highly efficient semiconductor manufacturing environments.

  • SECS/GEM & GEM300 Training for Engineers (20260715)

    Ahmedabad, India – July 2026 – eInnoSys, a leading provider of semiconductor factory automation solutions, is introducing its SECS/GEM and GEM300 Training Program for semiconductor equipment engineers, OEMs, fabs, and OSAT facilities at SEMICON India 2026. The training is designed to help engineering teams gain practical expertise in implementing SEMI automation standards and accelerating smart factory adoption.

    The program provides in-depth training on SECS-I (SEMI E4), SECS-II (SEMI E5), GEM (SEMI E30), HSMS (SEMI E37), and GEM300 standards, including E39, E40, E87, E90, E94, and E116. Participants will learn industry best practices for equipment communication, factory integration, host communication, state models, alarms, events, recipe management, carrier management, substrate tracking, and equipment automation.

    Delivered by experienced semiconductor automation specialists, the training combines classroom instruction with practical implementation exercises, enabling participants to build, configure, test, and troubleshoot SECS/GEM communication in real-world manufacturing environments. The curriculum is suitable for both Factory Automation Architects and Equipment Software Engineers working on semiconductor equipment development and integration.

    Key topics include:

    • SECS-I, SECS-II, GEM, and HSMS implementation
    • GEM300 standards and factory automation workflows
    • Equipment-to-Host and MES integration
    • Carrier Management and Substrate Tracking
    • Equipment state models, alarms, events, and reports
    • Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and compliance validation
    • Best practices for semiconductor equipment software development
    • Hands-on implementation using C#, .NET, and C++

  • EIGEMBox - Patented, Plug-n-Play SECS/GEM box for legacy equipment
    <p><a href="https://www.einnosys.com/eigembox/"><strong>EIGEMBox</strong></a> is a <strong>patented plug-and-play solution</strong> that enables SECS/GEM, Modbus, and OPC communication on existing semiconductor equipment without requiring any hardware or software modifications. By simply connecting to the equipment's VGA, DVI, or HDMI display output, and optionally the USB/PS/2 keyboard and mouse interfaces for remote control, EIGEMBox transforms legacy tools into fully connected smart factory assets.</p><p>Designed for Semiconductor Fabs, OSATs, and Equipment OEMs, EIGEMBox supports SEMI E5, E30, E37, E39, E40, E84, E87, E90, E94, and E116 standards, enabling seamless equipment-to-host communication, factory automation, and Industry 4.0 integration. It helps manufacturers avoid costly equipment upgrades, reduce implementation time, improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), enable remote monitoring, and accelerate smart factory adoption while preserving existing equipment functionality. The solution has been successfully deployed on 80+ semiconductor tools worldwide.</p><p><strong>Key Benefits</strong></p><ul><li>No hardware or software installation on the equipment</li><li>Plug-and-play implementation in hours</li><li>Supports SECS/GEM, Modbus, and OPC communication</li><li>Enables legacy equipment connectivity for Smart Factory initiatives</li><li>Fully compliant with major SEMI automation standards</li><li>Reduces automation costs and implementation risks</li><li>Supports <strong>OEE monitoring</strong> and <strong>Alarm Management System (AMS)</strong></li><li>Proven deployment across semiconductor FAB and OSAT environments<br /> </li></ul>...   • XPump – AI-based Predictive Maintenance System
    <p>xPump is an <strong>advanced AI/ML-powered predictive maintenance solution</strong> designed for real-time monitoring of vacuum pumps, booster pumps, dry pumps, exhaust systems, blowers, motors, and other motor-driven equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing. By continuously monitoring critical operating parameters such as vibration, temperature, current, voltage, and pressure, <a href="https://www.einnosys.com/xpump/">xPump</a> detects equipment anomalies early and predicts potential failures weeks before they occur, helping manufacturers minimize unplanned downtime and optimize maintenance schedules.</p><p>Built for Semiconductor Fabs, OSATs, and Equipment OEMs, xPump integrates seamlessly with existing factory systems, including SECS/GEM, MES, SCADA, and Industry 4.0 platforms, without disrupting production. Available as both edge and cloud deployments, the solution provides AI-driven health scores, automated alerts via email and SMS, real-time dashboards, and actionable insights that improve equipment reliability, Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), and maintenance efficiency while reducing operating costs.</p><p><strong>Key Benefits</strong></p><ul><li>AI/ML-based predictive maintenance</li><li>24×7 real-time equipment health monitoring</li><li>Early failure prediction before unexpected breakdowns</li><li>Supports pumps, motors, blowers, and exhaust systems</li><li>Improves OEE and equipment uptime</li><li>Reduces maintenance costs and Mean Time to Repair (MTTR)</li><li>Automated email and SMS notifications</li><li>Edge or cloud deployment options</li><li>Integrates with SECS/GEM, MES, SCADA, and factory automation systems</li><li>Non-intrusive implementation with minimal operational disruption</li></ul>...   • EIGEMLink – Universal Industrial Protocol to SECS/GEM Conversion Software
    <p>EIGEMLink is a powerful, enterprise-grade software solution that enables seamless conversion of industrial communication protocols into SECS/GEM, eliminating the need for custom programming or extensive engineering effort. It bridges protocols such as OPC UA, OPC DA, MQTT, Modbus TCP/RTU, EtherCAT, Profinet, Ethernet/IP, and PLC-based interfaces with SECS-II (SEMI E5), GEM (SEMI E30), and HSMS (SEMI E37), allowing semiconductor equipment to communicate effortlessly with Host, MES, and Factory Automation systems.</p><p>Designed for Semiconductor Fabs, OSATs, and Equipment OEMs, <a href="https://www.einnosys.com/eigemlink/"><strong>EIGEMLink</strong></a> provides a configurable, no-code platform that significantly reduces integration time while ensuring reliable, standards-compliant communication. The solution supports both 200mm and 300mm semiconductor manufacturing environments, making it ideal for connecting legacy equipment, PLCs, SCADA systems, and modern Industry 4.0 platforms without replacing existing infrastructure.<br /><br /><strong>Key Benefits</strong></p><ul><li>Universal protocol-to-SECS/GEM conversion</li><li>Supports OPC UA, OPC DA, MQTT, Modbus, EtherCAT, Profinet, Ethernet/IP, and PLC interfaces</li><li>No programming or SECS/GEM expertise required</li><li>Rapid deployment with configurable protocol mapping</li><li>Fully compliant with SEMI E5, E30, and E37 standards</li><li>Enables seamless integration with Host, MES, and Smart Factory systems</li><li>Reduces engineering costs and implementation time</li><li>Extends the life of legacy equipment without hardware replacement</li><li>Scalable for single-machine or enterprise-wide deployments</li><li>Ideal for Semiconductor, Electronics, Automotive, and Industry 4.0 applications</li></ul>...   • EIGaugeMonitor – AI-Powered Visual Inspection & Real-Time Analog Gauge Mo
    <p><a href="https://www.einnosys.com/eigaugemonitor/"><strong>EIGaugeMonitor</strong></a> is an AI-powered visual inspection and analog gauge monitoring solution that automates manual inspections by converting analog gauge readings and visual observations into real-time digital data.
